messages:
Maya: Quick sync  proposing a left-nav regroup: Models + Datasets + Embeddings under a single parent. Working label options: 'Assets' vs 'Library' vs 'Data & Models'. Main tradeoffs: permalink compatibility, keyboard nav, and breadcrumb semantics.

Omar: +1 on regroup. Permalinks are the main risk. We should accept legacy paths and normalize to canonical in the address bar without breaking back-button behavior. Client-side replaceState is probably the fastest.

Kevin: Example client rule: `if (location.pathname === '/models') history.replaceState(null, '', '/assets/models')`  shows canonical URL and avoids extra history entries.

Eli: Accessibility: ensure skip-to-content anchors still land inside the active workspace after any rewrite. Add `aria-current=\"page\"` on the active child item and `role=\"navigation\"` on breadcrumbs. When a permalink opens a panel, programmatically focus the panel heading and announce via a polite live region.

Lina: From testing, 'Assets' is concise and understood by power users; 'Library' confused a few novices. Recommend 'Assets' + microcopy: "Models, datasets, embeddings."

Maya: Shareable link strategy: short-term = hash/query snapshot (e.g., `#/assets/models?panel=insights&f=owner:me`) since its client-only. Long-term = shortlink service (`/s/abcd12`) that stores snapshot server-side.

Omar: For left-rail scroll, prefer storing offset keyed by cluster id in a tiny client map. Save on leave, restore on enter. `history.scrollRestoration` is flaky in SPA.

Kevin: I'll scope shortlink infra vs hash approach. Shortlink needs DB + ACL checks; estimate ~2 sprints. Hash approach can ship this sprint.

Eli: A11y follow-up: when restoring state from a permalink, call `panelHeading.focus({preventScroll:true})` and update `aria-live="polite"` text like "Panel opened: Insights" so screen readers get context. Also ensure focus order doesn't trap keyboard users in the rail.

Maya: Breadcrumb policy: `Workspace > Asset type > Asset name`. Breadcrumb links should reproduce the filtered context where it matters, but avoid bloating anchors with long query strings. Consider using a short query snapshot token for complex filters.

Omar: Action items: Omar -> prototype client-side aliases + per-cluster scroll store. Eli -> add a11y QA checklist for permalink flows. Kevin -> shortlink vs hash scoping. Lina -> finalize 'Assets' microcopy. Maya -> consolidate mockups + rollout note.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: D-8123 "Left nav regroup: Assets + permalinks + a11y" (assignee: Maya). :white_check_mark:

Maya: Thanks all  I'll post updated mockups in the channel later today for quick review.
